title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level Manga Ends With 19th Volume
content: The 18th compiled book volume of Yusuke Shiba 's manga adaptation of Kisetsu Morita 's I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level ( Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita ) light novel series revealed on Monday that the series will end with the next volume.

title: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea Game Delays Release to October 15
content: Natsume announced on Wednesday that Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea , the latest game in its Harvest Moon farming sim franchise, is launching on October 15, a delay from its previously announced September 24 release date.
